specimen.annotation_note: This entry arrived by import, not by hand: no robot_descriptions module covers the X500, so the tool cloned PX4's own PX4-gazebo-models repository directly and the facts above were parsed out of its x500_base SDF — the same file this entry's specs were originally read from. Nothing here was gated — importing a description is not a verdict.
honesty: The specimen covers x500_base, the base airframe model; PX4 composes its fuller variants (with cameras, lidar and gimbals) from this base, and those are not what was imported.

The SDF's total (2.064 kg) is the model's own bookkeeping — a 2.0 kg base link plus four 0.0160769 kg rotor links — not a weighed airframe; the entry already states it as the Gazebo model's sum, and it still does.
Gate status stays NOT_GATED: the motion gate grades wheeled ground robots, and no flight gate exists yet.
The parts kit stays undefined (kit: null in catalog/parts-kits.json): the kit generator builds wheeled kits from a spec's wheel block, and this robot has no wheels.
The SDF tree is not vendored into this repo — the manifest pins the upstream repo, commit and SDF path, and the license above was read from that repo's LICENSE file, not assumed.
